# Nikos Benakis

> Nikos Benakis is a Product Engineer, Growth Advisor, and Fractional CTO based in Athens, Greece. He co-founded Astrocode, a software agency that helps companies and startups move faster with AI, and angel invests in early-stage AI startups like Dikaio.ai.

## Background

- ~10 years across banking, consulting, and startups: EY, Fiserv, Workable (core ATS product), and Uizard (6th engineer, later Growth Tech Lead; shipped the AI feature Autodesigner) until its acquisition by Miro.
- Independent advisor and Fractional CTO to startups (seed to Series B) including Perspective, Futurae, Multiplier Holdings (AI Tech Advisor), Dikaio.ai, and Materia Labs, where he led InstaPharm.
- Studied Electrical and Electronics Engineering at the University of West Attica and holds a Masters in Software Development and AI from the University of Piraeus.
